result.paraphrase: WD Blue SN550 1TB NVMe M.2 2280 SSD (WDS100T2B0C) – NVMe performance at the core of your PC. Drive performance beyond SATA with lightning-fast, highly responsive storage. This WD Blue SN550 NVMe SSD delivers major gains over high-end SATA SSDs and gives resellers, system builders, and consumers a dependable NVMe storage option for new PCs. Offered in capacities up to 1TB and an M.2 2280 form factor, it provides the boost your system needs. Highlights: more than 4x faster than our SATA SSDs, with read speeds up to 2,400 MB/s for ultra-responsive PC performance; next-generation NVMe SSDs that improve system performance; slim M.2 2280 design; Western Digital–designed controller and firmware for optimized performance; Western Digital SSD Dashboard for constant drive health monitoring. A strong, cost-effective storage solution for your next PC, using PCIe NVMe Gen3 x4 interface. Sequential read speeds reach up to 2,400 MB/s to help productivity, while scalable NVMe hardware and accelerated architecture deliver high performance with low power consumption, maxing out at only 3.5W. Specifications: PCIe Gen3 8Gb/s interface, up to 4 lanes; formatted capacity 1TB; sequential read up to 2,400 MB/s (Q=32, T=1); sequential write up to 1950 MB/s (Q=32, T=1); random read 4KB up to 410K IOPS (Q=32, T=8); random write 4KB up to 405K IOPS (Q=32, T=8); endurance 600TBW; average active power 75mW; low power (PS3) 20mW; maximum operating power 4.9W; sleep (PS4) 5mW; MTTF 1.7M hours; operating temperature 32ºF to 158ºF (0ºC to 70ºC); non-operating temperature -67ºF to 185ºF (-55ºC to 85ºC); non-operating vibration 4.9 gRMS, 7-800 Hz, 3 axes; operating vibration 5 gRMS, 10-2000 Hz, 3 axes; shock 1,500G 0.5 ms half sine; certifications UL, TUV, FCC, BSMI, CE, KCC, RCM, Morocco, VCCI, and CAN ICES-3(B)/NMB-3(B); physical dimensions M.2 2280, length 82 ± 0.15mm, width 22 ± 0.15mm, height 2.38mm, weight 6.5g + 1g; 5-year limited warranty. Prices, features, and specifications may change without notice.
